title: Norwegian-Style Shrimp Skewers with French Twist
description: A delicate and elegant appetizer or side dish, perfect for a French-inspired dinner party. Succulent shrimp marinated in a mixture of Scandinavian flavors and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, parsley, dill, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Add the shrimp to the marinade and mix to coat.
Let the shrimp marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers.
Grill the shrimp skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Serve the shrimp skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley and lemon wedges if desired.
